question: Does Railway ask for a payment method when a Trial account reverts to the Free plan, what does a Free plan do when its USD 1 monthly credit is used up, and when does a Free plan's volume count as expired?
why: First-party pages say the trial needs no credit card and reverts to the Free plan; the pricing FAQ lists exhausted trial credits as a reason services stop and says to upgrade; the plans FAQ gives 30 days after expiry for the Free or Trial plan without defining expiry for a Free plan; the trial docs say a Trial account can spin up databases, and no first-party page says so for the Free plan itself. Railway Central Station replies (leads, not evidence: https://station.railway.com/billing/inquiry-about-free-plan-after-30-day-tri-309629ee, https://station.railway.com/questions/account-disabled-47f2aa66, https://station.railway.com/questions/deployment-eviction-93369202) say a Free plan's deployments stop when the USD 1 is used up, keep their data and return when the credit replenishes. Only an account shows it: unverified: behind a sign-up. It is an account step for the rq:operator issue.
